decl.intro: What we asked each supplier to declare per material, the answers and the decisions. Nothing reaches a supplier before Send; a portal is reached only once its switch is on for that supplier.

problem.origin: Two letters, as IT or PK.

why.MATERIAL_KIND: Not for this kind of material
why.MARKET: Not for the markets it is sold to
why.PRODUCT_TYPE: Not for the styles that use it

ruleCodeWhat.AZO: Azo dyes that release the listed aromatic amines are not allowed above the limit in textile and leather in contact with the skin.
ruleCodeWhat.NICKEL: Metal parts in long contact with the skin may not release nickel above the limit.
ruleCodeWhat.PAH: Rubber and plastic parts in contact with the skin may not hold the listed PAHs above the limit.
ruleCodeWhat.DMFU: Dimethyl fumarate (an anti-mould agent) is not allowed above the limit.
ruleCodeWhat.NPE: Textiles may not hold nonylphenol ethoxylates above the limit (they wash out into water).
ruleCodeWhat.CMR: Substances that cause cancer, change genes or harm reproduction are restricted in clothing.
ruleCodeWhat.PFAS: Per- and polyfluorinated substances are restricted (water-repellent finishes).
ruleCodeWhat.CR6: Leather in contact with the skin may not hold chromium VI at or above 3 mg/kg.
ruleCodeWhat.OTHER: A restriction of our own list or a brand's.

intro.substances: The restricted substances with their limits, where each comes from, and the Candidate List versions the SVHC declarations answer.
intro.rules: Each rule with its law, what proves it and its switch. A rule switched off says why; CMR and PFAS start off until a style or a market needs them.
intro.plans: Test plan rules: which substance test each lot of a material or kind needs, and how often. Tests are ordered from your lab at its price.

rsl.starterHint: The public-law substances and rules that are missing; nothing is overwritten.
rsl.starterBody: Adds the substances and rules of REACH Annex XVII that are missing (chromium VI, nickel, azo amines, PAHs, DMFu, NPE, CMR, PFAS). What is there already stays as it is.
rsl.starterOff: The CMR and PFAS rules come in switched off with their reason, until a style or a market needs them.
rsl.import: Import a list (AFIRM, a brand's RSL)…
rsl.importHint: Through the import flow, with a dry run first.

empty.title: No restricted substances yet
empty.body: Load the starter list of public law, then import your yearly AFIRM list or a brand's RSL.

rules.offBanner_one: {count} rule is switched off: it checks nothing until it is switched on.
rules.offBanner_other: {count} rules are switched off: they check nothing until they are switched on.

switch.onRule: From now on the rule is checked for every material it reaches, and their profiles are evaluated again.
switch.onPlan: From now on the lots it reaches show this test as due.
switch.offRule: The rule stops checking: materials are evaluated again without it.
switch.offPlan: Lots stop showing this test as due.
switch.reasonHint: The question it waits for, 3 to 500 characters: the next person reads it.
switch.reasonShort: Say why it is off, in 3 to 500 characters.

plan.lead: A lot's due tests come from these rules: a material's own rule wins over its kind's for the same test.
plan.marketHint: A market code (IT, FR, US-CA); empty for every market.
plan.ruleHint: Its limit judges the result; by default the test's switched-on rule.
plan.method: Method to ask the lab for
plan.methodHint: As written on the lab's report (EN ISO 14362-1).
plan.costHint: No price is kept here: the lab's price is on its own invoice.

empty.body: Say which lots must be tested for azo amines, nickel, PAHs and the rest, and how often.

problem.market: A market code like IT, FR or US-CA.

frequency.FIRST_LOT: The first lot of each supplier
frequency.ON_CHANGE: When the supplier or the colour changes

version.title: Record a Candidate List version
version.lead: When ECHA publishes a new Candidate List, record it here: SVHC declarations answered against an older list become "to ask again".
version.grew_one: {count} entry more than the version before: SVHC declarations of the older list are to ask again.
version.grew_other: {count} entries more than the version before: SVHC declarations of the older list are to ask again.
version.same: The same length as the version before.
version.none: No Candidate List version is recorded: SVHC declarations cannot be asked until one is.
version.failed: The Candidate List versions could not be read.

problem.day: Choose the day ECHA published it.

done.accepted: {number} accepted; its materials were evaluated again.

problem.forbidden: You may not do this here.

ask.conflict: Nothing was sent: every supplier and kind was skipped. Review again.
ask.invalid: The request was refused as it is: check the materials, the kinds and the due day.
ask.failed: The requests could not be sent: nothing went out. Try again.

cancel.conflict: It was answered or changed meanwhile: read it again.
cancel.failed: It could not be cancelled. Try again.

askAgain.conflict: It is answered: decide it first, or someone changed it meanwhile.
askAgain.invalid: Check the due day (today to 180 days ahead) and the cadence.
askAgain.failed: It could not be asked again. Try again.

accept.conflict: Not accepted: a material has no answer, the document was refused, or someone changed it meanwhile. Read it again.
accept.invalid: Check the validity day: not before the answer came.
accept.failed: It could not be accepted. Try again.

refuse.conflict: Someone decided it meanwhile: read it again.
refuse.failed: It could not be rejected. Try again.

lines.conflict: Someone changed it meanwhile, or a line names an SVHC that is not on the Candidate List: read it again.
lines.invalid: Check each answer: a concentration is a number.
lines.failed: The answers could not be saved. Try again.

answer.conflict: It was answered meanwhile: read it again.
answer.invalid: The file did not arrive, or the validity day is before the answer.
answer.failed: The answer could not be recorded. Try again.

take.conflict: It was answered meanwhile: read it again.
take.invalid: The supplier has not uploaded a declaration for it yet.
take.failed: The upload could not be taken. Try again.

preview.conflict: The supplier's portal is not open for a preview.
preview.invalid: The supplier's portal could not be opened.
preview.failed: The supplier's portal could not be opened. Try again.

evaluate.conflict: Someone changed a profile meanwhile: try again.
evaluate.failed: The evaluation could not run. Try again.

profile.conflict: Someone changed the profile meanwhile: it was read again.
profile.invalid: Check the country (two letters) and the note.
profile.failed: The profile could not be saved. Try again.

switch.conflict: It is switched that way already, or someone changed it meanwhile.
switch.invalid: Say why it is off, in 3 to 500 characters.
switch.failed: The switch could not be changed. Try again.

plan.conflict: Someone changed the rule meanwhile: read it again.
plan.invalid: Check the material or kind, the market and the method.
plan.failed: The test plan rule could not be saved. Try again.

version.conflict: A version of that day is recorded already.
version.invalid: Check the day (not in the future) and the number of entries.
version.failed: The version could not be recorded. Try again.

starter.conflict: The starter list could not be loaded as it is: read the list again.
starter.failed: The starter list could not be loaded. Try again.
